title: Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole
subtitle: Crispy tater tots baked with eggs, bacon, and melty cheese.
description: Tater tots, sausage, and cheese under baked eggs — tater tot hot dish meets breakfast casserole. Crowd-pleaser every time.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Grease a deep 9x13 pan. Cook bacon until crisp, drain, and crumble. Keep bacon fat if sautéing optional peppers.

steps.title: Layer tots and bacon
steps.instruction: Spread half the tater tots in an even layer on the pan bottom. Scatter bacon and half the cheddar over the tots. Add optional sautéed peppers if using.

steps.title: Add egg mixture
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Pour evenly over the layered tots and bacon so liquid reaches the bottom.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.instruction: Arrange remaining tots on top in a single layer and sprinkle with remaining cheddar. Bake 35–40 minutes until tots are deep golden and center reaches 165°F on a thermometer.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 8 minutes so the egg custard sets for clean scoops. Garnish with green onions and serve with ranch or hot sauce at the line.

stationWorkflow: Keep tots frozen until they hit the pan—thawed tots turn mushy in the egg layer.
Use a deep pan so the egg mixture does not overflow during baking.
Check center temp with a probe before pulling—golden tots can hide under-set eggs.
cleanupNotes: Line the pan with parchment for easier release and faster cleanup after cheese bakes on.
Wipe bacon grease splatter from the oven door while still warm.
leftovers: Reheat squares on a sheet pan at 375°F for 10 minutes to re-crisp the tot topping.
Crumble leftovers into a breakfast burrito with extra cheese and hot sauce.
